notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow managers!

We're happy to announce that game version 1.0.1 is now available!

Patch notes:

Save system bugs and missing dave data are fixed
Customers spawn system is updated and no longer spawns them in enclosed areas
Tuned the positioning of goods on shelves
Workers are no longer stuck in newly purchased zones
Minor bug fixing

Also, you may find our [url=https://discord.gg/Uncmgkt2Uj]discord server [/url]here for feedbacks and discussions!

Happy purchasing!
